result.question: Quais procedimentos, ordenados por volume decrescente, cobrem até 80% do total de atendimentos realizados?
result.gold_sql: SELECT nome_proc FROM (SELECT p."NOME_PROC" AS nome_proc, COUNT(*) AS total_atendimentos, ROUND(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_acumulado FROM atendimentos a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC") sub WHERE pct_acumulado <= 80 ORDER BY total_atendimentos DESC;
result.generated_sql: WITH procedimento_counts AS ( SELECT p."NOME_PROC", COUNT(*) AS total FROM atendimentos a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC" ), procedimento_totals AS ( SELECT SUM(total) AS total_atendimentos FROM procedimento_counts ), procedimento_cumulative AS ( SELECT pc."NOME_PROC", pc.total, SUM(pc.total) OVER (ORDER BY pc.total DESC) AS cumulative_total FROM procedimento_counts pc ) SELECT "NOME_PROC", total FROM procedimento_cumulative WHERE cumulative_total <= (SELECT total_atendimentos * 0.8 FROM procedimento_totals) ORDER BY total DESC;
